description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer offscreen-color checkpoint: existing safe host-write and virtual-bottom owners compose to preserve previously stored attributes when output continues below a manually scrolled viewport.

entries.notes: VirtualBottomState keeps cursor and virtual bottom on the output row when mouse-style viewport scrolling uses update_virtual_bottom=false, while HostWriteState writes only the new cell with the current symbolic TextAttribute. The witness reproduces Microsoft's colored-X/default-X/manual-scrollback/default-X sequence and proves the earlier red-on-blue cell remains unchanged.
